rules.question: What rescan cache does a scan get, and what does an empty or unreadable one mean?
rules.decision: concept audit M26 (code-only, D114 fix wave, task H1b)
rules.note: discover_charts takes the cache by reference and an empty cache is no help, so a caller has nothing to turn into a null pointer. load_scan_cache owns the swallowed read failure; each caller keeps its own save gate.
